def print_next_greater_freq(arr, n):
    from collections import Counter
    
    # Count the frequency of each element in the array
    freq = Counter(arr)
    
    # Stack to keep track of indices
    stack = []
    
    # Result array initialized with -1
    result = [-1] * n
    
    # Iterate over the array
    for i in range(n):
        # While stack is not empty and the frequency of the current element
        # is greater than the frequency of the element at the index stored at the top of the stack
        while stack and freq[arr[i]] > freq[arr[stack[-1]]]:
            # Update the result for the index at the top of the stack
            result[stack.pop()] = arr[i]
        
        # Push the current index onto the stack
        stack.append(i)
    
    # Print the result
    print(" ".join(map(str, result)))
